items.summary: Independent reviewer disposition: approve containment-only updates to existing reconciliation, failure-containment, measurement, bounded security-evidence, and private-launch work. Existing failures and measurement backlog require reconciliation before new production work. Authorize or decline the prepared permission request separately; until then, keep it unsent and the gated product private.
